# Contributing to Research Daily

Thank you for your interest in contributing! Here's how you can help.

## How to Contribute

### Report a Bug

Open an issue using the [Bug Report](https://github.com/Destined-at-Dawn/research-daily/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) template.

### Suggest a Feature

Open an issue using the [Feature Request](https://github.com/Destined-at-Dawn/research-daily/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) template.

### Submit Code

1. Fork the repository
2. Create your feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`)
3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`)
4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`)
5. Open a Pull Request

## Development Guidelines

- Keep the skill YAML file valid and well-documented
- Test your changes with actual paper inputs before submitting
- Follow the existing file structure and naming conventions

## Code of Conduct

Be respectful and constructive. We're all here to make research easier.
